stories.title: Six-year-old Chinese girl ‘sets new women’s Rubik’s Cube world record’
stories.summary: Six-year-old Lian Yunzhi of China broke the women’s 3x3 average Rubik’s Cube world record twice this month at World Cube Association certified competitions in Wuhan and Guangzhou. She posted averages of 4.52 and 4.27 seconds, becoming the first female speedcuber to average under 4.5 seconds, according to state media.

stories.title: OpenAI’s George Osborne says datacentre nimbys holding back Britain
stories.summary: George Osborne, a senior figure at OpenAI, said datacentre "nimbys" are holding back Britain and urged the UK to build more datacentres to maintain "sovereignty" over AI technology. His comments came in response to nationwide protests about the water- and energy-intensive structures.
